delete.description: Delete the named circuit (the undo is to run this skill again with the circuit's prior definition).

connection1.description: One end of the circuit: a device, its port, optionally a VLAN (1 to 4095) and a name. A circuit has exactly two connections, defined by hand; a query cannot generate one, and it is a statement you make, not something Forward observed.

connection2.description: The other end of the circuit, same shape as connection1.

backdate_snapshot_id.description: Apply the change to this existing snapshot and every later one now: they are invalidated, set UNPROCESSED, and not reprocessed for you. Cannot be undone; approve it separately.
